AnyValue.description: Any JSON value but null, at any depth: what an object may hold of a property that this version of the format does not define, which a consumer ignores (PRD §6.4).

AttributeDefId.description: An attribute definition's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

AttributeValues.description: Values of attributes, by their attribute definitions' IDs, each of its definition's type.

BoardId.description: A board's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

ComponentId.description: A component's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

Cursor.description: Where the flow is: its current node, and its phase.

nodeId.description: The current node, a node of the board that is no jumper.

phase.description: awaiting_choice when the node's choices are built and the game chooses one, or advances; ended when the flow ended at the node, after its on-exit ran (PRD §5.8.5).

NodeId.description: A node's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

ProjectId.description: A project's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

SaveState.description: The narrative state that a runtime saves and loads (PRD §8.5, FR-GODOT-07): where the flow is, and the values of the variables and the runtime attributes, and the nodes' visit counts, by ID, never by key.

attributes.description: The values of the components' runtime attributes, by the component's ID and the attribute definition's.

cursor.description: Where the flow is. Without it, the flow has not started.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the published format of the snapshot that the state was saved against.

snapshotId.description: The snapshot that the state was saved against. Without it, the state was saved against a draft (PRD §7.8).

snapshotVersion.description: The snapshot's version. Without it, the state was saved against a draft.

stateVersion.description: The version of the save-state format, 1, which a runtime of an older one refuses (PRD §8.5).

variables.description: The values of the variables, global and of each board, by their IDs, each of its variable's type.

visits.description: How many times the flow has entered each node that it has entered, by the node's ID; a node that it has not entered has none.

SnapshotId.description: A snapshot's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

Value.description: A value, which its declaration's type says how to read, never its JSON form (PRD §5.8.9): a boolean, a number, or a string.

VariableId.description: A variable's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

Visits.description: How many times the flow has entered each node that it has entered, by the node's ID.

description: The narrative state that a runtime's save_state() returns and load_state() reads (PRD §8.5, FR-GODOT-07). schema/save-state/README.md describes the format.
title: Storycreep save state, version 1
